description: Defensive heuristic triage rules. Findings are advisory only and require analyst review.
advisory_notice: Rules produce investigative hints, not malware verdicts or clean-endpoint proof.

rules.title: Process executing from temporary directory
rules.description: A running process image path resides under a temporary or user-writable directory.
rules.rationale: Legitimate software rarely runs persistently from temp paths; this may indicate staging.
rules.recommendation: Review process parent chain, signer metadata, and network connections for the same PID.

rules.title: Service executable in unexpected writable location
rules.description: A service references an executable whose directory appears writable by non-administrators.
rules.rationale: Writable service binary directories enable persistence via binary replacement.
rules.recommendation: Validate directory ACLs and recent modifications in the service path.

rules.title: Scheduled task references missing executable
rules.description: A scheduled task action points to a path that does not exist.
rules.rationale: Missing task targets may indicate cleanup after execution or dormant tasks.
rules.recommendation: Inspect task definition and last run times.

rules.title: Autorun entry references missing target
rules.description: A Run key or startup folder entry references a file that is not present.
rules.rationale: Broken autorun entries can reflect removed malware or incomplete cleanup.
rules.recommendation: Correlate with recent file metadata and login timelines.

rules.title: Listening service on all interfaces
rules.description: A network listener is bound to all interfaces rather than localhost.
rules.rationale: Broad listeners increase remote exposure; verify intended exposure.
rules.recommendation: Map owning process and firewall policy for the listener port.

rules.title: Process with unknown executable path
rules.description: A process record lacks a resolvable executable path.
rules.rationale: Missing paths may reflect permissions limits or intentionally obscured binaries.
rules.recommendation: Re-collect with elevated rights if authorized, or correlate by PID.

rules.title: Recently created persistence metadata
rules.description: Persistence metadata indicates a very recent creation timestamp.
rules.rationale: Recent persistence changes deserve timeline correlation during triage.
rules.recommendation: Compare creation time with case timeline and change tickets.

rules.title: SSH authorized_keys permission issue
rules.description: An authorized_keys file has overly permissive mode bits.
rules.rationale: Overly permissive authorized_keys modes weaken host authentication controls.
rules.recommendation: Confirm ownership and tighten mode to 600 or organizational standard.

rules.title: Unknown WMI permanent event subscription
rules.description: A permanent WMI event subscription was observed.
rules.rationale: Permanent WMI subscriptions are uncommon and historically used for persistence.
rules.recommendation: Validate filter/consumer legitimacy and change control records.

rules.title: Security tool status unavailable
rules.description: Expected security-tool status could not be collected.
rules.rationale: Missing security-tool visibility is a collection limitation or local gap.
rules.recommendation: Document limitation; re-collect with appropriate privileges if authorized.
